title: Steve Jobs - Apple Is Software
summary: A one-minute clip from the All Things D conference in which Steve Jobs says Apple is fundamentally a software company, with iPod, Mac and iPhone all being software. He says the hardware is where the money is but the value is in the software.
why: Quoted whenever someone needs Jobs's own words that Apple sees itself as a software company.

quote.text: The money is in the hardware but the value is in the software.
